scope: Actual published worker on a fresh official-schema database. Alternate existing table-lock barriers through wrapper validation, authoritative-hook validation and its fresh resource lookup; restore only the synthetic target binding reference and delete only its disposable binding before the final binding read. No worker function, live job, lease, clock or schema constraint is changed. Issued rows, transactions and encrypted OAuth material remain intact; no provider request is expected.
